package.name: bt_direction_stable
package.description: m5-ver3's one nav2 behaviour-tree decorator: DirectionStablePath, which refuses to swap the planned driving direction under a moving truck. AMR-DEC-004. The source lives in this repository; the build tree does not - tools/install_bt_direction.sh builds it into the user's own $HOME, which is tools/install_rf2o.sh's rule and its reason.
